controlled_language.tokenization: Exact UTF-8; one ASCII space at each shown separator; case-sensitive; no hidden normalization.
controlled_language.name_resolution: A PERSON token is one listed person label. A VARIABLE is x, y or z and must be lexically bound. The representation supplies distinct entity IDs; matching labels alone does not establish cross-source identity.
controlled_language.document_rule: A document is FORMULA followed by one literal full stop. Parentheses shown below are literal delimiters. Full stops do not occur inside FORMULA.

templates.semantics: FORALL VARIABLE over exactly the listed finite domain; replace PERSON in atom position by the bound VARIABLE

controlled_language.person_list_rule: One or more distinct PERSON tokens separated by a comma and one ASCII space; the resulting domain has exactly those members. Empty domains require accepted reference annotation and are outside this controlled surface grammar.
controlled_language.unsupported_surfaces: Pronouns, ellipsis, implicit context, unrestricted inflection, free quotation, unparenthesized operator scope, and surfaces without one of these productions remain reference/candidate input. The general relation model supports more than the controlled source grammar.

evaluation_rules.rule: NOT, AND, inclusive OR and IMPLIES use their ordinary Boolean truth tables within an identified context; evidence absence never assigns false.
FORALL and EXISTS range only over the supplied finite domain. Empty quantified domains have standard Boolean semantics, but an empty interpretation family never proves preservation.
Discourse and modality are typed context boundaries. No permission-to-event, quotation-to-assertion or supposition-to-fact conversion is implicit.
Role-bound argument tuples retain all arguments. Equality of one- or two-dimensional projections is not equality of an n-ary relation.
Entity, event and relation identity require correspondence evidence; equal labels or equal role patterns are insufficient.

Permitted equivalences: bound-variable alpha-renaming; AND/OR operand permutation and association inside the same context; role-preserving identity substitution using an accepted correspondence; explicit relation-group decomposition/recomposition. Each rewrite retains source anchors and target granularity.

Single-direction entailment, equal wording and similar wording are not general preservation proofs. Classical equivalence is scoped to a selected condition target; it does not erase quoted surface content or event identity.
Interpretation, correspondence and context choices form joint variants. Coupled choices are never expanded as an unconstrained Cartesian product.

Positive typed support rules require all conjunctive premises. Closure starts at bound base claims; unsupported cycles add no foundation. Retain alternative support paths and recompute after withdrawal without seeding old derived conclusions.
A claim and its negation form an explicit conflict. Evidence reasoning never derives arbitrary claims from that conflict.

trust_boundary.accepted_roots: Verifier configuration fixed independently of the submitted package. A bundled inventory is an object to bind, not permission to trust itself.
trust_boundary.reference_acceptance: accepted_reference results are conditional on the exact independently accepted annotation and do not establish world truth.
trust_boundary.candidate_scope: candidate_only outputs are limited to candidate_structures; every result and view retains its basis and claim_scope.

serialization.semantic_sets: sort ID-only sets lexicographically and entity/relation/target records by their declared primary ID; explicitly ordered argument and AST operand lists preserve their original order
serialization.source_binding: hash exact original bytes; no implicit NFC, newline, or whitespace normalization
serialization.claim: Profile-defined deterministic output encoding; no claim of JCS conformance.
